d:
Isaiah Thomas and Rudy Gay break down Paul George's 36 points on 14-for-22 shooting with six threes and five rebounds as the Celtics beat the 76ers, 123-101!
George took over in the fourth quarter, scoring 14 points on 5-for-7 shooting, including a 14-point run all by himself. Jayson Tatum added 21 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists, and Boston shot 50.5% from the field and 44.9% from three.
